note: THE SHAPE A LIVE CALL ANSWERED, 2026-09-22 — the first real reel’s canonical picture, on the seedream text wire: HTTP 200 with `width` and `height` NULL rather than absent. `z.number().optional()` refuses a null, so the adapter threw on a picture fal had already made and already billed for, and the run stopped with no receipt for it (S-133). The refusal named exactly `images.0.width` and `images.0.height`; the rest of this body is `fal-image-made`’s published shape, which the same call satisfied. What it proves is that a field this adapter does not read cannot refuse a picture it does read.
